prompt: As we are facing more and more problems, which affect the whole planet, good relationships between different countries are becoming more important than ever before. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that good relationships between different countries are becoming more important as the world faces an increasing number of global problems. I strongly agree with this view because international cooperation is essential for addressing shared challenges, and it can also promote economic and technological development.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that many global problems cannot be solved by individual countries. This is mainly because issues such as climate change, pandemics and environmental pollution affect several nations at the same time. In other words, governments need to cooperate by sharing information, technology and resources. For example, countries can work together on renewable energy research, which can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions. As a result, strong international relationships can contribute to more effective solutions to global challenges.

Furthermore, another important reason why good international relationships are essential is that they promote economic and technological cooperation. This is because countries can benefit from international trade, foreign investment and knowledge sharing. For instance, universities and research institutions from different countries can cooperate on scientific projects, which may lead to new technologies and practical solutions. Consequently, stronger international ties can create employment opportunities and support long-term economic development. Therefore, I strongly agree that good relationships between countries are more important than ever before.

In conclusion, I firmly agree with the view that good relationships between countries have become increasingly important. This is mainly because international cooperation is necessary to solve global challenges, and it can also support economic and technological development.
